race.comment: ENAMORADA (8) good fresh mare resuming with a solid winning CV. Finished off last preparation defeating Mr Miller and Night Agent over 1400m at this track in a BM72 last April. Fitted with the two trials and expected to play a leading role. SWEETHEARTED (3) showed brilliant acceleration first up when he came from midfield to salute in a tight finish over 1100m at Caulfield. Open to plenty of improvement and will be even stronger over this trip. OUI OUI OUI (10) made giant strides last prep which included a fast finishing eighth in the G3 Birthday Card over 1400m here last April. Sat up on the speed when returning with a tiring eighth over 1200m in the G3 The Nivison at Rosehill. Finds a much easier contest and don't dismiss from the draw. IL PASSERO (5) third-up today and won third-up previously. Pooly drawn again when he got back and covered a stack of ground to finish tenth over 1200m in a Bm94 at this track. Improver.
